title: Lusianthridin alleviates inflammatory responses and enhances protective autophagy via downregulation of c-Myc to ameliorate acute lung injury.
authors: Li, Ye; Li, Ang; Zhang, Weiquan; Zhang, Jiaozhen; Li, Juan; Wang, Yongjie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Lusianthridin通过下调转录因子c-Myc缓解急性肺损伤，虽涉及c-Myc与DNA互作及分子动力学模拟，但核心是药理学抗炎机制，非TF-DNA结合建模研究。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Lusianthridin (Lu) is a natural dihydrophenanthrene compound isolated from medicinal orchids including Bletilla striata Rchb.f. and Dendrobium venustum Teijsm. & Binn., which have been traditionally used in East Asian ethnomedicine for the treatment of pulmonary ailments such as cough, hemoptysis, and inflammatory disorders. However, the pharmacological effects and molecular mechanisms of Lu in acute lung injury (ALI) remain unexplored. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate whether Lu protects against ALI and to identify its molecular mechanism, with a particular focus on the transcription factor c-Myc as a potential therapeutic hub. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The anti-inflammatory and autophagy-modulating effects of Lu were evaluated using CuSO(4)-induced zebrafish, LPS-induced mouse ALI models, and LPS/IFN-gamma-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. Pulmonary pathology, edema, and inflammatory cytokines were evaluated in LPS-induced mice. NO and ROS levels, protein expression (Western blotting), and autophagic flux were assessed in LPS/IFN-gamma-stimulated RAW264.7 cells. Mechanistic studies integrated transcriptomics, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and genetic knockdown/overexpression approaches (c-Myc siRNA and overexpression plasmids). RESULTS: Lu significantly reduced inflammatory cell migration, pulmonary pathology, edema, and inflammatory cytokine production. Transcriptomics and molecular docking suggested that Lu interacts with the c-Myc/Max heterodimer, downregulating c-Myc expression. This downregulation subsequently inhibited the pro-inflammatory JAK2-STAT1/3 pathway and reduced iNOS and TNF-alpha expression. Concurrently, Lu relieved c-Myc-mediated suppression of protective autophagy, as evidenced by enhanced p62 degradation, increased LC3B-II conversion, upregulation of the mitophagy marker PINK1, restoration of mitochondrial membrane potential, and reduced BAX/Bcl-2 ratio. Genetic experiments confirmed that c-Myc knockdown phenocopied Lu effects, while c-Myc overexpression abolished Lu-induced protection. CONCLUSION: Both in vitro and in vivo models confirmed that Lu significantly attenuates pulmonary inflammation and injury in a c-Myc-dependent manner. These findings not only elucidate the molecular mechanism of Lu but also validate the ethnopharmacological use of medicinal orchids in pulmonary inflammatory conditions, positioning c-Myc as a promising therapeutic target for ALI intervention.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：Lusianthridin (Lu) 是一种天然的二氢菲类化合物，分离自药用兰科植物，包括白及（Bletilla striata Rchb.f.）和石斛（Dendrobium venustum Teijsm. & Binn.），这些植物在东亚民族医学中传统上用于治疗肺部疾病，如咳嗽、咯血和炎症性疾病。然而，Lu 在急性肺损伤（ALI）中的药理作用和分子机制尚未被探索。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨 Lu 是否对 ALI 具有保护作用，并鉴定其分子机制，特别关注转录因子 c-Myc 作为潜在的治疗靶点。材料与方法：使用 CuSO(4) 诱导的斑马鱼、LPS 诱导的小鼠 ALI 模型以及 LPS/IFN-gamma 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞评估 Lu 的抗炎和自噬调节作用。在 LPS 诱导的小鼠中评估肺病理、水肿和炎症细胞因子。在 LPS/IFN-gamma 刺激的 RAW264.7 细胞中评估 NO 和 ROS 水平、蛋白表达（Western blotting）和自噬通量。机制研究整合了转录组学、分子对接、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟以及遗传敲低/过表达方法（c-Myc siRNA 和过表达质粒）。结果：Lu 显著减少了炎症细胞迁移、肺病理、水肿和炎症细胞因子的产生。转录组学和分子对接表明，Lu 与 c-Myc/Max 异二聚体相互作用，下调 c-Myc 表达。这种下调随后抑制了促炎性 JAK2-STAT1/3 通路，并减少了 iNOS 和 TNF-alpha 的表达。同时，Lu 缓解了 c-Myc 介导的保护性自噬抑制，表现为 p62 降解增强、LC3B-II 转化增加、线粒体自噬标志物 PINK1 上调、线粒体膜电位恢复以及 BAX/Bcl-2 比值降低。遗传实验证实，c-Myc 敲低模拟了 Lu 的效果，而 c-Myc 过表达则消除了 Lu 诱导的保护作用。结论：体外和体内模型均证实，Lu 以 c-Myc 依赖性方式显著减轻肺部炎症和损伤。这些发现不仅阐明了 Lu 的分子机制，还验证了药用兰科植物在肺部炎症性疾病中的民族药理学应用，将 c-Myc 定位为 ALI 干预的有前景的治疗靶点。
